name: Pathé de Munt
description: Pathé de Munt is a large cinema in the centre of Amsterdam on the Vijzelstraat, close to Pathé Tuschinski; the two cinemas border each other behind the shops on the Reguliersbreestraat. It has 13 screens on three floors with 1,829 seats in total, the largest room seating 318.
funFact: When Pathé de Munt opened in November 2000 it was the first multiplex cinema in Amsterdam's inner city.
